registryBasis: Kadaster is the national cadastral custodian and PDOK publishes its official Kadastrale Kaart parcel service. No separate Eindhoven municipal cadastral custodian was evidenced; this is distinguished from general PDOK platform documentation.

requests.outcome: Anonymous collection metadata returned the Perceel collection, national geographic extent, supported CRS list, storage CRS EPSG:28992, and updated timestamp.
Anonymous schema returned stable UUID feature id, MultiPolygon geometry, and source fields. Source attributes were not retained.

Bounded anonymous bbox response returned two parcel MultiPolygons in GeoJSON/CRS84. The exact WUP point [51.4432163203009, 5.45844256201511] was preserved; the point is within the returned local query extent and no coordinate shifting was used.
